generated_response: Binary Search is an efficient algorithm for finding an item in a sorted list of items. It repeatedly divides the list in half, compares the target value to the middle element of the list, and then selects a half that could contain the target (or eliminates the other half). This process continues until the target is found or the list is exhausted. The time complexity of Binary Search is O(log n), making it highly efficient for large sorted lists.
